high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from news.mit.edu, dated 10:39. The content discusses the findings of neuroscientists regarding the human brain's "semantic hub" located in the anterior temporal lobe, which integrates semantic information from various modalities such as visual data and tactile inputs. The text explains that this semantic hub is connected to modality-specific "spokes" that route information to the hub. The MIT researchers found that large language models (LLMs) use a similar mechanism by abstractly processing data from diverse modalities in a central, generalized way.
